use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: The exchange is triggered when IFF/SIF surveillance data (Modes I, II, and III codes) becomes available to exchange.

C2 JU wants to exchange IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) with other JUs by reporting available IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.1/J3.5 messages and using J7.5 messages for IFF/SIF data management and reporting.

scope_contract.goal_statement: C2 JU wants to exchange IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) with other JUs by reporting available IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.1/J3.5 messages and using J7.5 messages for IFF/SIF data management and reporting.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU has IFF/SIF transponder data available to exchange and reports it in J3.1/J3.5 messages when available; associated IFF/SIF data management/reporting is handled through J7.5 messages, completing the exchange with other JUs.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU has IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) to exchange with other JUs.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been exchanged with other JUs via the appropriate J3.1/J3.5 and J7.5 messages.
in_scope_actions: Report/transmit available IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI=0) messages
Exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes using J7.5 messages
Perform IFF/SIF data management and reporting functions using J7.5 messages
Cover the five functional areas of IFF/SIF exchange: surveillance data reporting, unique Mode II code protection, clearing, difference resolution, and update request
excluded_adjacent_actions: Post-exchange administrative processing not performed through J3.1/J3.5 or J7.5 messages
Downstream actions taken after the IFF/SIF data has been exchanged
variant_dimensions: IFF/SIF mode being exchanged (Mode I, II, or III code)
Message type used (J3.1/J3.5 for surveillance data vs J7.5 for management/reporting)
J7.5 ACT variant (Clear, Difference Report, Update Request, or Special Code)

claims.content: If an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert (as required in Table 4.7-5), the operator shall have the following manual actions available for attempting resolution: (1) update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) initiate J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); (3) initiate J7.5 (ACT=1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode); (4) change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) decorrelate local data from remote data, causing assignment of a new track number to local data; and (6) clear the operator alert (any mode).

If the R² JU identifies an ID conflict, the operator is alerted and the local ID data continues to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1; the conflict is resolved by manual means. Exit: manual resolution of the conflict.

If a 'No Data' condition exists (no valid code is currently held for the subject local or remote track/mode, reported as zeroes in the applicable Mode Code field) and the R² unit transmits a J3.XC1 'NO DATA' report (value 0) for one or more modes while local nonzero IFF/SIF is held, this triggers a difference resolution response; a unit without R² receiving the report while holding valid non-current data must transmit its local data in a J7.5 (ACT=1) message (Action T1). Exit: the J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report is transmitted.

If a receiving unit's locally entered IFF/SIF data changes from zero to nonzero or from nonzero to another nonzero value, it may report a difference in accordance with Table 4.7-5 IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix by transmitting a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report. Exit: if the unit exercises this option, the J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report is transmitted.

If a JU with R² receives or initiates a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message that results in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track, it shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data. Exit: periodic J3 IFF/SIF continuation reporting for that track is stopped.

missing_aspects: main_flow was not provided, so exception branches cannot be tied to specific main_flow step numbers
Explicit confirmation that the flow exits upon the operator selecting one of these actions.

claims.content: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been successfully exchanged in the applicable J-series message (J3.1/J3.5 for surveillance data or J7.5 for management actions).
After successful exchange, if the locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from previously reported PPLI message data, that local IFF/SIF data has been reported.

After the exchange, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message is reported as value 2 if all nonzero mode codes match those received in the J2 message, value 1 if only Mode II matches, and value 0 otherwise, based on actual responses rather than prior PPLI receipt.

After a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message has been transmitted and accepted, the designated mode(s) for the specified track are set to No Data status on all receiving JUs; if the transmitting unit has R² responsibility, it has stopped transmitting the periodic J3 message containing the continuation word for that track.
After successful completion of a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report transmission, the reported difference is communicated to relevant units, completing the exchange function.
After successful exchange via a J7.5 (ACT=2) Update Request message, the receiving units have responded by transmitting their local data codes.

After successful completion of the exchange, the system state reflects: (a) for a J7.5 (ACT=3) Special Code exchange, all nonzero special codes for that track have been reported as part of the completed transaction and the originating JU has assumed J7.5 (ACT=3) reporting responsibility for retransmission until a special code message is received for that track from another unit, the track is dropped, or a clear special code is received; and (b) a valid Mode II code for a specific local track is inhibited from change, a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message designating all modes or Mode II code returns the Mode II code status to No Data, and a Mode II code change detected by local sensors is treated as a new track.
C2 JU

Diverges from Step 2 (periodic J3.1/J3.5 IFF/SIF surveillance reporting): instead of continuing to report valid data, a JU with R² may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message to clear one or more modes on the specified track; all JUs receiving the message automatically set the designated mode(s) for that track to No Data status, and the initiating JU stops transmitting the periodic J3 message containing the continuation word for that track.

Diverges from Step 2 (periodic J3.1/J3.5 IFF/SIF surveillance reporting): instead of reporting valid nonzero data, the R² unit may report a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required J3.XC1 surveillance data report; receiving units holding valid nonzero data respond as required by the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.

Diverges from Step 5 (C2 JU initiates a J7.5 (ACT=2) IFF/SIF Update Request via operator action): initiated by operator action, the C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=2) IFF/SIF Update Request to request updated transponder data from another unit; receiving units respond by transmitting their local data codes.

Diverges from Step 3 (J7.5 IFF/SIF data management/reporting): the C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=1) IFF/SIF Difference Report, initiated by operator action at any time, to report a difference in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.
Diverges from Step 3 (J7.5 IFF/SIF data management/reporting): the C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=3) Special Code message to exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes.
IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) is available.

The C2 JU's reporting responsibility for the relevant Air and Surface tracks is established: an R² JU is responsible for reporting IFF/SIF surveillance data, while a non-R² JU monitors such data and reports differences via J7.5 only if it holds different data.
The validity status of IFF/SIF codes for established tracks has been determined as either Valid Data or No Data.
The C2 JU has IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) available to exchange and, as the unit with R², has reporting responsibility for the track.
The C2 JU periodically transmits the valid IFF/SIF data held for the track in J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI=0) messages.
All other JUs without R² monitor the reported IFF/SIF surveillance data and, if they hold different data than the R² unit, report it by transmitting a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report message.
For IFF/SIF data management and reporting, the C2 JU selects the appropriate J7.5 IFF/SIF Management action: Clear, Difference Report, Update Request, or Special Code.
The C2 JU transmits the J7.5 message with the selected action value (ACT=0, ACT=1, ACT=2, or ACT=3) to perform the corresponding management/reporting function.

quality_flags.detail: [altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claims at array indexes 2-4 state they diverge from main_flow Step 3, but main_flow Step 3 concerns non-R2 JUs monitoring and sending a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report. The C2 JU's J7.5 management actions (Update Request, Difference Report, Special Code) are selected and transmitted in Step 4 and Step 5, so Step 3 is not the correct attachment point for these alternatives. (unsupported action None for direct apply)

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception Flow claim 1 describes six operator manual actions for attempting resolution of an IFF/SIF data conflict alert but does not state an exit/outcome. It ends with the menu of actions, leaving the branch dangling: no return to a main-flow step, no terminal state, and no explicit 'alert remains unresolved' condition. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The cited cards do not state that the exception flow ends when the operator clears the operator alert; explicit recovery/exit evidence is needed.))

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception_flow claim 1 describes an IFF/SIF data conflict alert and lists six manual actions available to the operator for attempting resolution, but it stops after listing the options. It does not specify a clear outcome/exit for the branch, such as returning to a main_flow step, terminating/handing off, or an explicit terminal failure/prevention state. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence that clearing the operator alert terminates the exception flow.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Main Flow contains no step that establishes the Mode II code protection state required by Postcondition 6(b). The Main Flow only transmits J3.1/J3.5 surveillance data and J7.5 management messages, but Postcondition 6(b) additionally requires that a valid Mode II code is inhibited from change, a Clear IFF/SIF action returns the Mode II code to No Data, and a sensor-detected Mode II code change is treated as a new track. None of the Main Flow actions reasonably leads to these outcomes, so Postcondition 6(b) is not reachable.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 4 (index 3) says it diverges from Step 3, but main_flow Step 3 is about 'All other JUs without R²' monitoring and reporting differences; the C2 JU's J7.5 IFF/SIF management actions, including the Difference Report, are in main_flow Steps 4 and 5. Attaching this C2 JU branch to Step 3 is therefore a logically unrelated divergence point.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 5 (index 4) says it diverges from Step 3, but Step 3 is not a C2 JU J7.5 management step; it describes other JUs' monitoring and difference reporting. The Special Code transmission is one of the C2 JU management actions in main_flow Steps 4 and 5, so the attachment to Step 3 is logically unrelated.

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception flow claim 1 describes the conflict-alert branch by listing six manual actions available to the operator, but it never states the outcome after the operator selects or executes one of those actions. There is no return to a main_flow step, termination/handoff, or explicit terminal failure/prevention state.

inconsistency_hints: The Main Flow includes J7.5 Special Code (ACT=3) as one of the selectable management actions and the scope contract includes unique Mode II code protection and exchange of special-meaning IFF/SIF codes, but the Postconditions slot defines success states only for the J3.1/J3.5 surveillance exchange, Clear (ACT=0), Difference Report (ACT=1), and Update Request (ACT=2). There is no postcondition covering the Special Code exchange outcome or the unique Mode II protection outcome, so the vertical flow from Main Flow to Postconditions is incomplete for these promised actions.

The alternative_flow claims at indices 2, 3, and 4 all state they diverge from main_flow Step 3 and label it 'J7.5 IFF/SIF data management/reporting.' However, main_flow Step 3 is specifically about all other JUs without R² monitoring and transmitting a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report. The C2 JU's selection/transmission of J7.5 management actions occurs in main_flow Steps 4 and 5, so the referenced divergence point is logically attached to the wrong step.
